name: LLM Space
description: Prototypes, traces, replays, and evaluates LLM agents in a local macOS desktop app, and exports threads as runnable LangGraph agents, for agent builders.

skills.name: Agent Run Tracing
skills.description: Shows every model call and tool run inside the agent loop as it happens.

skills.name: Replay Debugging
skills.description: Replays a run from history and steps through it to locate failures.

skills.name: LangGraph Project Generation
skills.description: Turns a thread into a runnable LangGraph agent project.
